name: Input group
summary: An input joined with text addons, icons or buttons inside one box, such as a URL prefix, a currency or a search button.
description: The group draws the border and focus ring; the input, addons and buttons inside are bare. Keep addons short: a unit or a prefix, not a sentence.

classes.name: v-input-group
classes.description: The box around the parts. It takes the focus ring and the invalid border of the input inside.

classes.name: v-input-addon
classes.description: Text or an icon at the start or end, such as https:// or €.

states.description: On the inner input: the whole group gets the danger border.
On the inner input: the whole group is dimmed.

a11y: The label points at the input (<label for>), not at the group.
Addon text is not part of the label; if the unit matters (per site, per month), repeat it in the label or a hint.
Icon addons are decoration: mark the svg aria-hidden="true".
A button in the group needs its own visible text or an aria-label.
